## Checklist

- [ ] I understand and have reviewed the change.
- [ ] I added relevant positive and negative tests.
- [ ] I did not rewrite a released task or historical result.
- [ ] No raw jobs, account data, credentials, private prompts or unlicensed assets.
- [ ] I read the README public-data terms and approved these exact files for public upload.
- [ ] I can publicly share this evidence under its declared license; gaps/redactions are disclosed.
- [ ] All paid runs were explicitly authorized; all attempts are disclosed.
- [ ] A green CI result is not claimed as independent score verification.
